mentions.name: Academy Referral
mentions.description: A referral platform for martial arts academies that lets academy owners reward students with points for bringing in new members.
mentions.problem: There are no point-based reward programs for referring people to martial arts, even though such programs exist for nearly everything else, so students who bring in new members go unrewarded.
mentions.audience: Martial arts academy owners, who use it to reward their students
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on Academy Referral* (https://academyreferral.com). It's a referral platform for martial arts academies, allowing owners to reward their students for bringing in new members.

evidence.value: I'm currently working on Academy Referral* (https://academyreferral.com). It's a referral platform for martial arts academies, allowing owners to reward their students for bringing in new members.
